It requires careful translation of quantum-mechanical formulas into code, but the approach is an established, published method (not novel).
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential stages (solving matrices, oscillator strengths, Faraday parameters) that produce two CSV files. All stages are pure numerical Python (NumPy/SciPy) with no external tooling, data fetching, or environment complexity. I/O is straightforward.
